question: Who is considered the manufacturer after a substantial modification of machinery?
value: The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is treated as the manufacturer under Art. 18 of the Regulation, and must ensure and declare conformity on its sole responsibility; a non-professional user modifying machinery solely for its own use is not considered a manufacturer.
text: Under Article 18 of the Regulation, the natural or legal person carrying out a substantial modification (one that affects the safety of only the machinery or a related product in an assembly) becomes subject to the manufacturer's obligations and must ensure and declare conformity on its sole responsibility; a non-professional user modifying machinery for its own use is excluded.

steps.quote: A non-professional user who carries out a substantial modification to his or her machinery or related product, for his or her own use, shall not be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10.

steps.text: natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification: hasObligation = shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10 (condition: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery)
steps.quote: Article 18 Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply A natural or legal person that carries out a substantial modification of machinery or a related product shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Article 10 for that machinery or related product or, if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of machinery, for that affected machinery or related product, as demonstrated in the risk assessment.

question: For the periodic verifications after the first one of Annex VII equipment, is the employer obliged to apply to the ASL (local health authority), being allowed to use an authorised body only once thirty days from the request have elapsed?
